lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Pip's Shape Hunt!
It was a sunny morning at the playground. Mama Bunny brought a big picnic basket.
Pip Puppy wagged his tail. Wag, wag, wag!
Woof! Let's play a game! A shape hunt!
A shape hunt? What is that, Pip?
We look all around for shapes. A circle, a square, and a triangle!
What a fun idea, Pip. Let's remember the shapes first.
A circle is round, round, round. A square has four sides, all the same. A triangle has three sides and three pointy corners.
Let's find them all before our picnic!
Will you help us hunt? Yay! Let's go!
First, a circle. Round, round, round. Hmm.
Can you find a circle? Look all around!
Look up, Pip! The sun is a big, round circle!
Yes! The sun is a circle! And look down here...
My red ball! It is round, round, round. My ball is a circle too!
Pip gave the ball a little push. It rolled and rolled, because circles can roll!
Can you draw a circle in the air with your finger? Round and round!
Great job! What a lovely circle!
Quack! My turn! Now we need a square.
Four sides, all the same. Where can it be?
Ooh! What is that blue thing by the swing?
It is a toy block! Is it a square?
Let's count the sides together. One, two, three, four!
Four sides, all the same. It is a square!
And what is on the square block? Can you see it?
A little yellow star! Woof, I love stars!
Can you find a square at your home? Maybe a window, or a book!
Squares are everywhere!
Now Pip looked for a triangle. He looked by the tree. He looked in the flowers.
Hmm. Three sides and three pointy corners. Where is a triangle?
Pip looked and looked, but he could not find one. That's okay, Pip. Let's keep looking!
I will keep trying! Sniff, sniff!
Picnic time! I made yummy jam sandwiches.
Wait! Look at the sandwich! What shape is it?
A triangle! Three sides and three corners! Woof, woof!
Let's count the corners. One, two, three!
And look at the swing, Pip! The swing legs make triangles too!
We found a circle, a square, and a triangle! We did it!
Pip had two sandwich halves. He looked at Dotty.
Dotty, do you want one of my triangles? Sharing is fun!
Thank you, Pip! You are a kind friend.
Look! Our picnic blanket has lots of little squares!
Let's play a shape riddle. Round, round, round, and it can roll. What shape is it?
A circle!
Four sides, all the same. What shape is it?
A square!
Three sides and three pointy corners. What shape is it?
A triangle! Hooray!
Let's sing our shape song! Use your finger and draw with me!
Circle, circle, round and round. Draw a circle, round and round!
Square, square, one, two, three, four. Draw a square, then draw some more!
Triangle, triangle, one, two, three. Make a triangle, just like me!
Shapes, shapes, everywhere! Shapes, shapes, here and there!
After the picnic, the friends sat in the warm sun. They took a big, slow breath in, and a long breath out.
Thank you for hunting shapes with me! Shapes are everywhere.
What shape will you find today? Bye bye, friends! Woof!
The end. Watch more stories on Honey Bunny Kidz!
